text: Added a tool-scoped reciprocal zarr-java 0.1.3 oracle without any Scala build dependency: the wrapper pins Unidata netcdfAll 5.9.1 by published SHA-256 3ba80b2b2125028ebcb4d98034b165dfca5a5dddaeaad5fa41ab211aa378fc72, passed the Zarr-Python start-indexed sharded fixture, and generated an exact direct v3 int16 fixture pinned by separate metadata/chunk hashes for a new shared JVM/Scala.js reader suite. A deliberate wrong-shape input failed at the oracle boundary. The shared Scala suite is source-complete but remains unexecuted until sbt is explicitly authorized.
